metadata.title: Stag — The Future of Internship Discovery
metadata.description: A centralized platform bridging the gap between universities and enterprises. Skill-based matching, automated document generation, and placement tracking.

hero.headline: The Future of Internship Discovery
hero.description1: A centralized platform bridging the gap between universities and enterprises. Skill-based matching, automated document generation, and placement tracking—all in one elegant system.
hero.description2: Within the framework of MESRS strategy to strengthen the University-Enterprise link, Stag digitizes the entire internship lifecycle from discovery to official Convention de Stage.

metadata.title: About — Stag
metadata.description: Learn about Stag's mission to digitize the internship lifecycle and strengthen the University-Enterprise link.

hero.headline: Bridging University & Enterprise
hero.description: Within the framework of MESRS strategy to strengthen the University-Enterprise link, Stag digitizes the entire internship lifecycle from discovery to official Convention de Stage.

paragraphs.p1: The internship process in Algeria has long been fragmented—students search manually, companies manage paper applications, and universities handle piles of administrative documents.
paragraphs.p2: Stag was built to solve this. A single platform where students discover opportunities matched to their skills, companies manage talent pipelines efficiently, and administrators generate official documents with one click.
paragraphs.p3: Aligned with the MESRS strategy to modernize higher education, Stag digitizes every step: from the initial search to the final Convention de Stage and completion certificate.

reliability.title: Reliability

metadata.title: Privacy Policy - Stag
metadata.description: Learn what data Stag stores, why it is used, and how to contact us about privacy requests.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Stag.io is operated by the platform team reachable at support@stag.io. This notice describes how the service handles account data, internship workflow records, messages, documents, and optional assistant integrations.

collection.title: What we collect
collection.body: We collect account details, profile information, applications, interview and placement records, uploaded documents, messages, and limited technical logs needed to run the platform. If a company admin connects external tools, Arcade handles delegated GitHub or Gmail authorization for that account.

usage.title: How we use it
usage.body: We use this data to authenticate users through Better Auth, coordinate applications and validations, generate documents, send operational email, protect forms with Cloudflare Turnstile when enabled, and power assistant requests through an OpenAI-compatible provider when the feature is enabled. Uploaded files are stored in S3-compatible object storage.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: We keep operational records while accounts and internship workflows remain active, then retain only what is required for audit, support, fraud prevention, or document verification. Session cookies expire automatically, and connected-tool access can be revoked through the linked provider flow.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Stag.io privacy and data requests can be sent to support@stag.io. Include the account email, document code, or company/university details relevant to the request so the platform team can identify the correct records.

metadata.title: Terms of Service - Stag
metadata.description: Review the terms that govern access to Stag for students, companies, universities, and administrators.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms govern use of Stag by students, companies, universities, and administrators. By creating an account or using the platform, you agree to use it responsibly and provide accurate information.

accounts.title: Accounts and access
accounts.body: You are responsible for keeping credentials secure and for ensuring the information attached to your account is accurate and current. Access may be limited, suspended, or revoked when verification fails or platform rules are breached.

conduct.title: Acceptable use
conduct.body: Do not submit fraudulent offers, impersonate other users, scrape protected data, abuse messaging, or attempt to bypass role, approval, or security controls. Platform activity may be reviewed when abuse or policy violations are reported.

documents.title: Documents and records
documents.body: Generated agreements, certificates, and verification records reflect workflow data stored on the platform. Users are responsible for reviewing submitted information before validation or issuance.

support.title: Support and changes
support.body: We may update the platform, policies, or operational requirements as the service evolves. Material changes to these terms will be reflected on this page. Formal notices, legal requests, and support inquiries can be sent to support@stag.io.

metadata.title: Cookie Policy - Stag
metadata.description: Understand how Stag uses cookies and similar storage for sessions, preferences, and operational measurement.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: Stag uses cookies and similar browser storage for authentication, security, interface preferences, and optional abuse protection. The service does not ship advertising trackers by default.

essential.title: Essential cookies
essential.body: Essential cookies come from Better Auth session handling and related sign-in flows. Without them, protected pages, role checks, and account security features cannot function.

preferences.title: Preference storage
preferences.body: The platform stores interface choices such as sidebar state and locale or presentation preferences so dashboard navigation opens the way you left it.

analytics.title: Security and abuse prevention
analytics.body: When enabled, Cloudflare Turnstile and server-side operational logs help detect automated abuse, debug failures, and monitor reliability. These signals are used for service protection rather than advertising profiling.

contact.title: Managing cookies
contact.body: You can clear cookies in your browser at any time. If you need help understanding which stored values affect access to your account, contact support@stag.io.
